chunks: And ʿAlī ibn Jaʿfar asked his brother Mūsā ibn Jaʿfar عليهما السلام about a woman who has only one outer wrap: how should she pray? He said:
"She should wrap herself in it, cover her head, and pray. If her legs become exposed and she is unable to do otherwise, then there is no harm."

key_terms.تَلْتَفُّ: she wraps herself in the garment
key_terms.فَلَا بَأْسَ: there is no harm or legal objection
key_terms.مِلْحَفَةٌ: a single wrapping garment or outer cover

ai.seo_question: How should a woman perform salat if she has only one garment and cannot fully cover her legs?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a fiqh ruling for a woman praying when she possesses only a single garment. She should use it to wrap herself and cover her head, and if her legs remain exposed due to necessity and inability to cover them otherwise, her salat is still valid without blame.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.1083 - Ali ibn Ja'far asked his brother Imam Musa ibn Jafar Al-Kadhim (as) about a woman who has only one cover (milhafa). How should She pray?
Imam (as) said: "She should wrap herself in it and cover her head, and then pray. If her legs are exposed and She is unable to cover them in any other way, then there is no harm."
